rule: This bounded native-default adapter requires exactly one source receptor chain/segid. Retain every multi-chain source condition as assembly_protocol_unsupported; never remove a source chain, merge chain identities or run an unvalidated assembly-grouping/restraint adaptation.
source_facts: libcns.prepare_multiple_input counts unique chains/segids as ncomponents; native_segid=True assigns one prot_segid_i per chain.
Native rigidbody separates, rotates and minimizes each chain as an independent component, even when several receptor chains came from one PDB input file.
Default flexref nseg_i=-1 chooses flexible residues near any other segment, including receptor-receptor interfaces, and creates rigid groups per segment.
mol_fix_origin_i can prevent corresponding rigidbody placement/motion but does not fix its atoms during flexrefMD; nseg=0 does not join receptor chains into a single body.
interpretation: Unsupported bounded adapter/workflow under the deliberately preserved full-assembly constraint. This is not a claim that the HADDOCK algorithm cannot dock multi-chain receptors. A future validated source-protein-only assembly-restraint/grouping adaptation would require a separate freeze.
